value.rationale: The sharp half-order threshold, including the logarithmic critical endpoint, isolates a structural transition in a natural fractional smoothing of the new counterexample. The pathologies occur for atomless positive-real symbols, not only boundary point masses, and are maximally graph-nonclosable. This addresses the mathematical gap left by the qualitative counterexample and differentiates canonical closed from formal coefficients.
